In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule, a '''resistance''' was formed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reynon]]. [[Harovan Toth]] was originally a member, before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] proper.
